title: Repairing Standard (private rented housing, Scotland): checklist categories
label: reference only
legal_status: Reference only, never a legal test. Short summaries of the categories in section 13(1) of the Housing (Scotland) Act 2006, for a renter's checklist. Haven can't decide whether a home meets the standard; the statutory text and the First-tier Tribunal (Housing and Property Chamber) do.
edition: Housing (Scotland) Act 2006 s.13, revised text up to date with changes in force on or before 7 November 2026 (latest amendment 6 October 2026, S.S.I. 2026/173). Outstanding changes listed on legislation.gov.uk don't alter the lettered paragraphs of s.13(1).
licence_note: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (legislation.gov.uk, Crown copyright).
extraction: Category names and summaries are Haven's own short paraphrases of each paragraph; read the statutory text at source_url for the exact wording.

items.category: Wind and water tight, fit to live in
items.summary: The house is wind and water tight and in all other respects reasonably fit for human habitation.
items.label: reference only

items.summary: Structure and exterior, including drains, gutters and external pipes, in reasonable repair and proper working order.
items.label: reference only

items.category: Water, gas, electricity, sanitation and heating
items.summary: Installations for water, gas, electricity (including residual current devices), other fuel, sanitation, space heating by a fixed heating system and heating water in reasonable repair and proper working order.
items.label: reference only

items.summary: Fixtures, fittings and appliances provided by the landlord in reasonable repair and proper working order.
items.label: reference only

items.summary: Furnishings provided by the landlord capable of being used safely for their purpose.
items.label: reference only

items.summary: The house meets the tolerable standard.
items.label: reference only

items.summary: The house is substantially free from damp and mould (in force from 6 October 2026).
items.label: reference only

items.summary: Any common parts pertaining to the house can be safely accessed and used.
items.label: reference only

items.summary: Satisfactory provision for, and safe access to, a food storage area and a food preparation space.
items.label: reference only

items.summary: Where the house is in a tenement, common doors are secure and fitted with satisfactory emergency exit locks.
items.label: reference only
